summary: refactor(settings): remove resume token logic from getUniqueUserId
description:
Because:

- getUniqueUserId still read a uniqueUserId from a ?resume= token.
- No code on main writes uniqueUserId into a resume token now.

This commit:

- Removes the resume token read path and the orphaned Sentry import.
- Fixes stale comments in getUniqueUserId.
- Adds unit tests for getUniqueUserId.

Closes FXA-11310
